analysis_frame.scope: Conditional one-coordinate loss. Inserting V at boundary283 reconstructs FGAVD; source transcription retains the four observed glyphs.

records.readable_german: Seit 1 / 11 / 18 ergibt sich jedoch das Bild, dass die serbischen Armeen mit 3 franz. Div. im Vormarsch gegen Belgrad, SHMENDRIA begriffen sind und der bei VID8N und OO2PALANKA beabsichtigte Angriff aufgegeben zu sein scheint.
records.meaning: For the period beginning 1/11/18, the report assesses that the Serbian armies with 3 French divisions are advancing toward Belgrade and the literal place label SHMENDRIA; the attack planned near the literal labels VID8N and OO2PALANKA appears to have been abandoned. This is the report's assessment, not independent evidence of the actual movements.

limits: The literal source has377 valid coordinates, one fewer than RICHI378. The readable decoding is conditional on one inserted coordinate; the original odd frame and orphan coordinate are retained separately.

All378 single-insertion boundaries are priced against the exact baseline template. The unique minimum at283 has13 observed substitutions plus one inserted V; it lies inside the visibly short FGAD group. This is template-dependent compatibility, not proof of every historical damage model.
Baseline place labels SHMENDRIA,VID8N and OO2PALANKA remain literal. Optional SEMENDRIA,VIDIN and LOMPALANKA cost four additional observed substitutions and are excluded from baseline totals.
The date1/11/18 and count3 are unchanged. Word-like0 and7 labels changed in VORMARSCH,GEGEN and AUFGEGEBEN are explicitly listed coordinate repairs, not an unpriced numeral reassignment.
Historical report decipherment and published-key attribution remain with their prior authors; no first-solution priority is claimed.
